name: Papaya Global
description: Papaya Global is a global workforce payments platform providing Employer of Record (EOR), Contractor of Record (COR), self-managed contractor payments, and global payroll processing for enterprises, unifying HRIS/ERP/VMS data through an AI layer called OneData and orchestrating employment and payments across 180+ countries.
best_for: Enterprises that need to employ, pay, and stay compliant with workers, both employees and contractors, across many countries under one platform, with the vendor assuming compliance and misclassification liability.
features: Employer of Record (EOR) employment across 180+ countries, with Papaya assuming compliance liability
Contractor of Record (COR) service for compliant contractor engagement
Contingent OS for managing contingent/contractor workforces at scale
Self-managed contractor payment solution for paying international contractors directly
Payroll Plus for global payroll processing and payments consolidation
OneData: an AI layer that maps HRIS, ERP, and VMS systems such as Workday, SAP, and BambooHR into a single data fabric
Papaya One: an agentic knowledge base covering 95+ jurisdictions for compliance questions, contract review, and compliant document drafting
AI agents that classify contractors, route payments through corridors, and detect compliance anomalies, with human experts validating decisions
Worker self-service tools including payslip viewing, invoice submission, worker wallets, and early-payment/factoring options
OnePay global payments with no platform fee, described as pay-only-when-you-pay with guaranteed FX rates
pros: Publishes 'starting from' numeric pricing for EOR, Contractor of Record, contractor payments, and Payroll Plus rather than requiring a quote to see any price
States it assumes compliance and misclassification liability on its EOR and contingent-workforce products
Lists SOC 1 & 2 Type II, ISO 27001 & 27701, and CSA STAR compliance, and names J.P. Morgan and Citi as banking rails, on its homepage
cons: Published prices are explicitly 'starting from' floors; the actual quote for a given country and role requires contacting sales and can be materially higher
Workforce OS and Contingent OS bundles show no numeric price at all, only 'Get a Quote'
No self-serve free trial is offered; onboarding goes through a demo or quote request
